title: LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool
title_zh: LeCuration: 一个小型世界模型作为数据整理多用途工具

paragraphs.en: Robot Learning with World Models: Capabilities, Frontiers, and Challenges
paragraphs.zh: 基于世界模型的机器人学习：能力、前沿与挑战

paragraphs.en: Many applications of physical AI run within finite or closed physical worlds with a limited set of physical laws governing object behavior. Examples include robots working in a warehouse and agents moving around in a video game. In order to better organize, filter, and curate data for physical AI applications, we propose a new approach centered on the unique settings and physical laws of individual datasets. We train LeCuration, a small world model intended to serve as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model . To build this model, we choose LeWorldModel (LeWM) ( Maes et al., 2026 ) as our latent encoder and predictor, adding a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to add visuals to autoregressive gameplay rollout. We find that the embeddings of this model can be used as an anomaly detection signal and as a content-based clustering heuristic, and that auto-regressively predicting the game state with this model allows us to qualitatively check for action-state consistency. This paper presents a qualitative, proof-of-concept case study on CS:GO gameplay data; we do not yet report quantitative curation metrics or downstream training results, which we identify as the key next step.
paragraphs.zh: 许多物理人工智能的应用都在有限或封闭的物理世界中运行，这些世界由一套有限的物理定律来规范物体的行为。 例如，在仓库中工作的机器人以及在电子游戏中四处移动的智能体。 为了更好地组织、筛选和整理物理人工智能应用的数据，我们提出了一种新方法，该方法以每个数据集的独特设置和物理定律为中心。 我们训练了 LeCuration，这是一个小世界模型，旨在为另一个更大的下游模型提供数据整理工具。 为了构建这个模型，我们选择 LeWorldModel (LeWM)（Maes 等人，2026）作为我们的潜在编码器和预测器，并添加一个扩散变换器（DiT）解码器，为自回归的游戏过程生成视觉内容。 我们发现，该模型的嵌入向量可以用作异常检测信号和内容基于的聚类启发式方法，并且使用此模型对游戏状态进行自回归预测，使我们能够定性检查动作与状态之间的一致性。 本文呈现了一项关于《CS:GO》游戏数据的定性概念验证案例研究；我们尚未报告量化的数据整理指标或下游训练结果，而这些正是我们确定的关键下一步工作。

paragraphs.en: Intelligently curating data prior to training is key to ensuring a high quality model, especially for use cases in physical AI. The straightforward alternative, feeding a model everything, teaches it the full distribution of the source data, including its degenerate corners. Filtering by hand does not scale. Rule-based filters require access to the physics engine state, which is hidden in most cases or impossible to access if your physics engine is the real world. Most importantly, it is impossible to understand the effect of a curated dataset without training a model on it. Therefore, we need a small, quickly trainable curation that has learned enough about a dataset to characterize it, identifying what is typical, what is rare, and what is surprising.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练前对数据进行智能筛选，是确保模型高质量的关键，尤其是在物理人工智能的应用场景中。 另一种简单的方法是将所有数据直接输入模型，这会使其学习到源数据的完整分布，包括那些退化的极端情况。 手动筛选无法实现规模化应用。 基于规则的筛选需要访问物理引擎的状态，而在大多数情况下，这一状态是隐藏的；如果你的物理引擎就是现实世界，甚至根本无法访问。 最重要的是，如果不基于该数据集训练模型，就不可能理解经过筛选的数据集所产生的影响。 因此，我们需要一个规模小、训练迅速的数据筛选机制，它需要足够了解数据集的特征，能够识别出其中的典型内容、罕见内容以及令人意外的内容。

paragraphs.en: We train such a model on Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) gameplay recordings. LeCuration is a deliberately small model: the encoder has roughly 2M parameters, the predictor roughly 13M. By training it on this dataset in a matter of hours, we allow the model to produce representations and predictions that are semantically meaningful enough to drive curation decisions at scale. On top of this, we built a diffusion decoder as a visualization tool, letting us decode embeddings back to pixels to inspect what the model has learned.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在《反恐精英：全球攻势》（CS:GO）的游戏录像上训练这样一个模型。 LeCuration 是一个刻意设计得较小的模型：编码器约有 200 万个参数，预测器约有 1300 万个参数。 通过在数小时内用该数据集对其进行训练，我们使模型能够生成在语义上足够有意义的表示和预测，从而支持大规模的内容策展决策。 此外，我们还构建了一个扩散解码器作为可视化工具，使我们能够将嵌入向量解码回像素，以检查模型所学到的内容。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, this paper’s contributions are: (1) an adaptation of LeWM into a compact, quickly-trained curation tool operating on a TAESD latent space (Sec. 2 ); (2) a qualitative demonstration that its embeddings organize gameplay footage into semantically coherent clusters usable for rebalancing and degenerate-content filtering (Sec. 3 ); and (3) an unsupervised anomaly signal, derived from autoregressive embedding divergence, that flags frames where the predictor’s expectation and the observed frame disagree (Sec. 4 ). We emphasize that this is a proof-of-concept study: we validate these primitives qualitatively on a single CS:GO map, and we have not yet trained a downstream model on LeCuration-curated data or established quantitative metrics for any of the three primitives above; we discuss this scope explicitly in Sec. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，本文的贡献包括：(1) 将 LeWM 改编为一种紧凑且训练迅速的策展工具，该工具可在 TAESD 潜在空间上运行（第 2 节）；(2) 通过定性演示证明，其嵌入能够将游戏过程片段组织成语义连贯的聚类，可用于重新平衡和过滤退化内容（第 3 节）；以及 (3) 一种无监督异常信号，该信号源自自回归嵌入差异，用于标记预测器的期望与观测帧不一致的帧（第 4 节）。 我们强调，这是一项概念验证研究：我们在一张 CS:GO 地图上对这些基础方法进行了定性验证，但尚未在 LeCuration 策展的数据上训练下游模型，也未为上述三种基础方法建立定量指标；我们在第 5 节中明确讨论了这一研究范围。

paragraphs.en: The JEPA model training paradigm has been applied almost exclusively to two settings.
paragraphs.zh: JEPA 模型训练范式几乎完全应用于两种场景。

paragraphs.en: The first is visual control and robot planning : V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) trains on over one million hours of internet video to enable zero-shot robot manipulation by planning in latent space; Causal-JEPA ( Nam et al., 2026 ) introduces object-level latent interventions to learn causal world structure; JEPA-based LiDAR models ( Zhu and Choromanska, 2026 ) apply the same framework to spatiotemporal occupancy forecasting for autonomous driving.
paragraphs.zh: 第一类是视觉控制与机器人规划：V-JEPA 2（Assran 等，2025）通过在超过一百万小时的互联网视频上进行训练，实现了在潜在空间中规划以达成零样本机器人操作；Causal-JEPA（Nam 等，2026）引入了对象级别的潜在干预，以学习因果世界结构；基于 JEPA 的 LiDAR 模型（Zhu 和 Choromanska，2026）则将同一框架应用于时空占用预测，用于自动驾驶。

paragraphs.en: The second is representation learning for downstream classification and video understanding : I-JEPA, V-JEPA, and VL-JEPA all frame prediction as a pretext task for learning transferable visual features.
paragraphs.zh: 第二项是面向下游分类和视频理解的表示学习：I-JEPA、V-JEPA 和 VL-JEPA 都将预测任务视为一种预训练任务，用于学习可迁移的视觉特征。

paragraphs.en: In every case, the JEPA model is the end consumer of its own representations. The learned embeddings and predictions are used either to plan the model’s own actions or to evaluate the model’s own performance on a benchmark task. In contrast, this paper investigates the application of the learned representations for data curation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有情况下，JEPA 模型都是自己表示的最终使用者。 所学习的嵌入和预测要么用于规划模型自身的行动，要么用于评估模型在基准任务上的自身表现。 相比之下，本文研究了将所学表示应用于数据整理任务的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The inspiration of LeCuration is LeWorldModel (LeWM) ( Maes et al., 2026 ) . LeWM’s central contribution is a stable end-to-end JEPA that trains directly from raw pixels using only two loss terms: a next-embedding prediction loss and a Sketch Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) that prevents representation collapse without stop-gradients, frozen encoders, or exponential moving averages. Much like the rest of the works in the space, LeWM is presented entirely as a planning and control model. Given a goal frame, the predictor optimizes a sequence of actions whose predicted latent trajectory minimizes distance to the goal embedding.
paragraphs.zh: LeCuration 的灵感来源是 LeWorldModel (LeWM)（Maes 等人，2026）。 LeWM 的核心贡献是一种稳定的端到端 JEPA，它仅使用两个损失项直接从原始像素进行训练：下一个嵌入预测损失和 Sketch Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer（SIGReg），后者能在不引入梯度停止、冻结编码器或指数移动平均的情况下防止表示坍缩。 与该领域其他研究类似，LeWM 完全被呈现为一个规划与控制模型。 给定一个目标帧，预测器会优化一系列动作，其预测的潜在轨迹与目标嵌入的距离最小化。

paragraphs.en: At roughly 15M parameters, it is among the most compact world models that have demonstrated competitive performance on continuous control benchmarks. The smaller the model, the faster it trains, and the more practical it is to adapt it to new datasets if it is deployed in production.
paragraphs.zh: 其参数规模约为 1500 万，属于在连续控制基准测试中展现出竞争力的最紧凑型世界模型之一。 模型越小，训练速度就越快；如果部署到生产环境，将其适配到新数据集也会更加实用。

paragraphs.en: The authors establish the model’s rich latent-space properties in their ablations. Physical quantity probing shows that agent position, object location, and object orientation are linearly recoverable from the CLS embedding (which is trained to be the overall per-frame world state). Surprise evaluation shows that the model assigns higher prediction error to physically implausible events (teleporting objects) than to matched visual perturbations that do not violate physics. Additionally, temporal path straightening shows that latent trajectories become increasingly linear during training, a property the authors argue reflects the emergence of a smooth, locally Euclidean world model.
paragraphs.zh: 作者在消融实验中确立了该模型丰富的潜在空间特性。 物理量探测表明，智能体位置、物体位置和物体朝向可以从 CLS 嵌入（其训练目标是表示每帧的整体世界状态）中线性恢复。 惊讶度评估显示，对于物理上不合理的事件（物体瞬移），模型赋予的预测误差高于那些不违反物理规律的匹配视觉扰动。 此外，时间路径拉直实验表明，潜在轨迹在训练过程中变得越来越线性，作者认为这一特性反映了平滑且局部欧几里得的世界模型的涌现。

paragraphs.en: LeWM is not just a single-frame encoder model. While each frame is indeed individually encoded to the latent space, the predictor module of LeWM actually uses a history of 6 6 previous vectors before predicting the next latent world state. This allows the model to understand the kinematics of domain-specific data, predicting world state not just from position, but also from velocity.
paragraphs.zh: LeWM 不仅仅是一个单帧编码器模型。 虽然每一帧确实会被单独编码到潜在空间中，但 LeWM 的预测模块实际上会利用前 6 个历史向量来预测下一个潜在世界状态。 这使得该模型能够理解特定领域数据的运动学特性，不仅根据位置，还能根据速度来预测世界状态。

sents.en: While each frame is indeed individually encoded to the latent space, the predictor module of LeWM actually uses a history of 6 6 previous vectors before predicting the next latent world state.

sents.en: This allows the model to understand the kinematics of domain-specific data, predicting world state not just from position, but also from velocity.
sents.zh: 这使得该模型能够理解特定领域数据的运动学特性，不仅根据位置，还能根据速度来预测世界状态。

paragraphs.en: We modify LeWM for a fundamentally different use: as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model , rather than as a planner. LeCuration does not plan actions and is not evaluated on any control benchmark. Instead, its embeddings and predictor outputs are used to analyze the training corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 LeWM 进行了修改，用于一种截然不同的用途：作为为另一个更大规模的下游模型进行数据整理工具，而非用作规划器。 LeCuration 不会规划行动，也不在任何控制基准上进行评估。 相反，其嵌入表示和预测器输出被用来分析训练语料库。

paragraphs.en: Through this adaptation, we uncover several interesting properties. By clustering the embeddings, we find that we can qualitatively separate training data into visually and semantically distinct groups, such as frames from different map locations and camera framings (Sec. 3 ); we have not measured this against ground-truth location or orientation labels. We can also run the predictor module autoregressively and compare the predictions with the encoded ground truth to find any possible anomalies or unexpected shifts in data. In addition, we build a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to recover gameplay frames conditioned on autoregressive CLS tokens output by the predictor module. By feeding a starting frame and a sequence of actions (key pushes) into the model, we are able to reconstruct near-photorealistic gameplay video from only a sequence of 196-dimensional world-state vectors, showing that despite its small size and very quick training time, LeCuration can indeed model the laws of a physics engine.
paragraphs.zh: 通过这种适应，我们发现了一些有趣的特性。 通过对嵌入向量进行聚类，我们发现可以从视觉和语义上将训练数据划分为不同的组别，例如来自不同地图位置和不同摄像机视角的帧（第 3 节）；但我们尚未将其与真实位置或方向标签进行比较验证。 我们还可以以自回归方式运行预测模块，并将预测结果与编码后的真实数据进行比较，从而发现任何可能的异常或数据中的意外变化。 此外，我们构建了一个扩散变换器（DiT）解码器，以便根据预测模块输出的自回归 CLS 令牌来恢复游戏画面帧。 通过将初始帧和一系列动作（按键操作）输入模型，我们仅凭一组 196 维的世界状态向量就能重建出近乎真实的游戏视频，这表明尽管 LeCuration 的规模很小且训练时间极短，它确实能够模拟物理引擎的运行规律。

paragraphs.en: While we take inspiration from both the architecture and training recipe of LeWM, we make major modifications, as shown in Figure 1 , to improve training speed and fit our goals of applying it to data curation problems.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们从 LeWM 的架构和训练方案中汲取了灵感，但我们对其进行了重大修改（如第 1 图所示），以提高训练速度，并使其更适合应用于数据整理问题。

paragraphs.en: LeWM encodes directly from pixels. We decide to instead map our entire dataset to a much smaller intermediate latent representation before any training. We choose to use the same autoencoder as Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2021 ) , as it has been standard practice, and is able to do 48 × 48\times compression while losing relatively few important details. However, the autoencoder used by Stable Diffusion has 74 74 M parameters, and a much more efficient alternative, called Tiny AutoEncoder for Stable Diffusion (TAESD) ( Bohan, 2023 ) , accomplishes the exact same task at a fraction of the cost. Distilled from the standard Stable Diffusion autoencoder, TAESD only has 2.4 2.4 M parameters and a single forward pass is roughly 20 × 20\times faster than that of the original autoencoder on the same device ( Bohan, 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LeWM 直接从像素进行编码。 我们决定在开始任何训练之前，先将整个数据集映射到一个小得多的中间潜在表示。 我们选择使用与 Stable Diffusion（Rombach 等人，2021）相同的自编码器，因为这是标准做法，并且能够在损失相对较少的关键细节的同时实现 48 × 48 的压缩。 然而，Stable Diffusion 使用的自编码器有 7474 万个参数，而一个名为“用于 Stable Diffusion 的微型自编码器”（TAESD）（Bohan，2023）的高效替代方案，以极低的成本实现了完全相同的功能。 TAESD 是从标准 Stable Diffusion 自编码器中蒸馏而来的，仅包含 240 万个参数，并且在同一设备上单次前向传播的速度比原始自编码器快约 20 倍（Bohan，2023）。

Each frame has a corresponding action vector, which is a 51 51 -dimensional one-hot encoded vector representing the keys pressed at that frame (key presses, mouse movements, and so on).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的数据集从 224 × 224 × 3 的帧压缩为 4 × 28 × 28 的 TAESD 潜在表示。 每一帧都对应一个动作向量，这是一个 51 维的一热编码向量，表示该帧中按下的按键（如按键、鼠标移动等）。

paragraphs.en: The latent encoder and predictor were inspired by LeWM but adapted to the TAESD latent space. The Latent Encoder is a patch-ViT operating on TAESD latents (patch size 4 4 , 49 49 spatial patches plus a CLS token [the world state], projected to 196 196 dimensions via 4 4 transformer layers). For each gameplay frame, it produces a single 196 196 -dimensional world state e t + 1 e_{t+1} (the CLS token) that summarizes the frame’s content. The patch tokens are discarded after each forward pass.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在编码器和预测器的设计灵感来自 LeWM，但已针对 TAESD 潜在空间进行了调整。 潜在编码器是一个基于 patch-ViT 的模型，作用于 TAESD 潜在数据（块大小为 4×4，包含 49 个空间块和一个 CLS 标记 [世界状态]，通过 4 层 Transformer 将其投影到 196 维）。 对于每一帧游戏画面，该模型会生成一个 196 维的世界状态 e_{t+1}（即 CLS 标记），以概括该帧的内容。 每次前向传播后，块标记都会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: The latent predictor is a causal transformer ( 512 512 hidden dimension, 8 8 layers, 16 16 heads) that takes a sliding window history of 6 6 frame embeddings plus action embeddings and predicts the next frame’s embedding. Actions are projected to 196 196 dimensions by a small action embedder before being fed to the predictor. The action embedder is a 1d-convolution (kernel_size=10, stride=1) followed by a 2-layer MLP (hidden_dim=768) which transforms the 51-dimensional one-hot encoded action vector into a 196-dim embedding.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在预测器是一个因果变换器（隐藏维度为 512，层数为 8，头数为 16），它接收一个包含 6 帧嵌入和动作嵌入的滑动窗口历史数据，并预测下一帧的嵌入。 在输入预测器之前，动作会通过一个小型动作嵌入器投影到 196 维空间。 动作嵌入器由一个一维卷积层（kernel_size=10，stride=1）和一个两层 MLP（hidden_dim=768）组成，可将 51 维的一热编码动作向量转换为 196 维的嵌入。

paragraphs.en: At each autoregressive step the predictor outputs world state e ^ t + 1 \hat{e}_{t+1} : its expectation of what the next frame should look like in embedding space, given the recent context and the action taken. The quality of this prediction—and in particular the gap between e ^ t + 1 \hat{e}_{t+1} and the observed e t + 1 e_{t+1} —is the primary curation signal.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个自回归步骤中，预测器会输出世界状态 e ^ t + 1 \hat{e}_{t+1}：即基于近期上下文和已执行的动作，对下一帧在嵌入空间中应有的形态的预测。 这种预测的质量——尤其是 e ^ t + 1 \hat{e}_{t+1} 与观测到的 e t + 1 e_{t+1} 之间的差距——是主要的筛选信号。

paragraphs.en: We pre-encode and shard all frames in the dataset as TAESD latents. Performing this forward pass exactly once per frame not only saves redundant compute, but slashes I/O cost, as (1) 48 × 48\times less data is fetched per training step and (2) compressing the dataset allows us to fit all of the frames and corresponding actions on disk, so that we don’t have to repeatedly fetch batches from our cloud bucket.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将数据集中所有帧预先编码并分片为 TAESD 潜在表示。 每帧仅执行一次此前向传播不仅能节省冗余计算，还能大幅降低 I/O 成本：（1）每个训练步骤获取的数据量减少了 48 × 48 倍，且（2）通过压缩数据集，我们能够将所有帧及对应的动作完整存储在磁盘上，从而无需反复从云存储桶中获取批次数据。

sents.zh: 没有标签，没有碰撞标注，也没有物理监督——只有游戏视频和操作。

paragraphs.en: There are two stages of training for the latent encoder and predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在编码器和预测器的训练分为两个阶段。

paragraphs.en: First, we pre-train the encoder on randomly sampled frame-action pair sequences, asking the encoder to find the world state of 6 6 history frames and the predictor to predict only the next immediate world state. This allows the encoder to form initial representations for the training data.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们在随机采样的帧-动作对序列上对编码器进行预训练，要求编码器找出前 6 个历史帧的世界状态，并要求预测器仅预测下一个直接的世界状态。 这使得编码器能够为训练数据形成初始表示。

sents.en: First, we pre-train the encoder on randomly sampled frame-action pair sequences, asking the encoder to find the world state of 6 6 history frames and the predictor to predict only the next immediate world state.
sents.zh: 首先，我们在随机采样的帧-动作对序列上对编码器进行预训练，要求编码器找出前 6 个历史帧的世界状态，并要求预测器仅预测下一个直接的世界状态。

sents.en: This allows the encoder to form initial representations for the training data.
sents.zh: 这使得编码器能够为训练数据形成初始表示。

paragraphs.en: Next, we do supervised auto-regressive post-training, where, starting from a window of 6 6 frames, we ask the predictor to auto-regressively roll out word states for the next 50 50 frames, comparing them with the world states encoded directly from the ground truth frames. We use a discount factor of 1.03 1.03 to emphasize frames further away. This significantly improves the quality of longer rollouts from the predictor, and also allows the encoder to refine its world state embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们进行监督式自回归后训练：从 6 个帧的窗口开始，要求预测器对接下来的 50 个帧进行自回归式地推演词状态，并将其与直接从真实帧编码得到的世界状态进行比较。 我们使用 1.03 的折扣因子来强调更远处的帧。 这显著提升了预测器在更长序列推演中的质量，同时也使编码器能够优化其世界状态嵌入。

paragraphs.en: No part of the model is frozen in either of these two stages. Pre-training takes 120 minutes for 300 300 epochs, and post-training takes 60 minutes for 20 20 epochs. We define an epoch to be 1600 batches, rather than a full pass through the entire dataset. Pre-training batch size is 32 32 and post-training is 16 16 . A batch denotes 7 7 frame-action pairs in pre-training ( 6 6 history frames + 1 1 current frame) and 56 56 frame-action pairs in post-training.

paragraphs.en: For the DiT decoder, we embedded TAESD latents from the dataset as world states with the trained latent encoder, and trained the decoder to generate the TAESD latents conditioned on each world state. This way, the DiT decoder performance is unable to affect the world model quality. This step was also very fast (30 mins for 600 epochs).
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DiT 解码器，我们使用训练好的潜在编码器将数据集中的 TAESD 潜在变量嵌入为世界状态，并训练解码器在给定每个世界状态的情况下生成 TAESD 潜在变量。 这样，DiT 解码器的性能就无法影响世界模型的质量。 这一步也非常快速（600 个周期仅需 30 分钟）。

paragraphs.en: The dataset in our experiments in this paper is composed of CS:GO gameplay recordings of various skill levels restricted exclusively to the de_dust2 map. The data was provided anonymously by our data partner. Both frames and key presses are sampled at 16 16 Hz. No curation or episode filtering is applied at training time; the model can be used for curation applications after being trained on the full, uncurated set. The idea is to train LeCuration on any training corpus and then apply it to curate sample-efficient training sets.

paragraphs.en: We qualitatively evaluate the embedding and predictor outputs in the context of addressing the common data curation challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在应对常见数据整理挑战的背景下，对嵌入和预测器的输出进行了定性评估。

paragraphs.en: We extracted one million CLS embeddings from the training corpus and ran UMAP + HDBSCAN to cluster them. The clusters correspond to recognizable gameplay situations—long open sightlines, close-quarter interiors, smoke-obscured views, player silhouettes at doorframes—without any semantic labels having been provided. The self-supervised prediction objective has organized the space by content, not by pixel statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从训练语料中提取了一百万个 CLS 嵌入向量，并运行 UMAP + HDBSCAN 对其进行聚类。 这些聚类对应于可识别的游戏场景——长距离开阔视野、近距离室内环境、烟雾遮挡的视野以及门框处的玩家轮廓——而无需提供任何语义标签。 这种自监督预测目标是根据内容而非像素统计信息来组织了空间结构。

paragraphs.en: This cluster structure provides direct curation primitives. Rebalancing : over-represented clusters (common corridor walks, static standoffs) can be downsampled at episode selection time to improve training diversity. Degenerate-content filtering : clusters corresponding to loading screens, spectator views, and scope views (the first row of Figure 2 ) or heavily compressed frames can be easily filtered out, without per-frame labels.
paragraphs.zh: 这种聚类结构提供了直接的策展基础功能。 重新平衡：过度代表的聚类（常见的走廊行走、静态对峙）可以在回合选择时进行下采样，以提高训练多样性。 退化内容过滤：对应于加载界面、旁观视角和范围视角（图 2 的第一行）或高度压缩帧的聚类，无需逐帧标签即可轻松过滤掉。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the embedding geometry is meaningful independently of the generative decoder, we ran a nearest-neighbor retrieval experiment. At each step of an auto-regressive rollout, instead of rendering the predicted embedding with the DiT, we snap it to its nearest neighbor (by Euclidean distance) in the 1M-frame subset of our training data. We decode and append the corresponding TAESD latent through the VAE directly to generate the video. If the embedding space is coherent, the retrieved frame should be visually consistent with what the model predicted.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试嵌入几何结构是否独立于生成解码器而具有意义，我们进行了一项最近邻检索实验。 在自回归展开的每一步中，我们没有使用 DiT 渲染预测的嵌入，而是将其对齐到训练数据中 100 万帧子集里与其欧几里得距离最近的邻居。 我们通过 VAE 直接解码并附加相应的 TAESD 潜在变量，以生成视频。 如果嵌入空间是连贯的，那么检索到的帧在视觉上应与模型预测的结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Studying the world states with nearest-neighbor retrieval allowed us to find some of its weaknesses. A major weakness is that the weapon in the player’s hand is often misrepresented. This can be seen in the third row of Figure 2 , where the location and camera angles of the clustered frames are obviously the same, but the weapon is not. When playing an auto-regressively predicted sequence of nearest-neighbor snapped frames, the weapon type often flickers in the player’s hand. This is likely because the weapon takes up significantly less space on the screen than the surrounding scene, meaning it has a much smaller effect on the final loss value. Also, the action inputs that involve the weapon, firing, and switching, are much less common than moving around and turning. This is the kind of result that proves the usefulness of training a small scout model. If we were to train a larger model afterwards, we would know to create a curated finetuning set that oversamples weapon switches and firing to improve accuracy in this aspect.
paragraphs.zh: 通过最近邻检索研究世界状态，使我们能够发现其中的一些弱点。 一个主要弱点是玩家手中的武器常常被错误呈现。 这一点可以从图 2 的第三行看出：聚类帧的位置和摄像头角度明显相同，但武器却并非如此。 在播放通过最近邻自动回归预测的帧序列时，玩家手中的武器类型常常会闪烁不定。 这可能是因为武器在屏幕上占据的空间远小于周围场景，因此对最终损失值的影响也小得多。 此外，涉及武器使用、开火和切换的动作输入，比移动和转向要少见得多。 这类结果证明了训练一个小型侦察模型的有效性。 如果之后我们训练一个更大的模型，就会知道需要创建一个精心挑选的微调数据集，对武器切换和开火进行过采样，以提升这一方面的准确性。

paragraphs.en: We used the per-episode embedding centroids to select training episodes by farthest-first traversal (maximizing spread in the 196-dimensional space). By construction, coverage-maximizing selection produces a more diverse training corpus with less redundancy than random sampling. We have not yet trained a downstream world model on these subsets, so we do not yet know whether this translates into comparable downstream quality at a reduced training budget; validating this is the most important open question raised by this work (see Sec. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用每集嵌入向量的中心点，通过最远优先遍历（在 196 维空间中最大化分布）来选择训练集。 根据构造方式，以覆盖度最大化为目标的选择方法能够生成比随机采样更具多样性且冗余更少的训练语料库。 我们尚未在这些子集上训练下游世界模型，因此目前尚不清楚这种方法是否能在减少训练成本的同时保持相当的下游模型质量；验证这一点是这项工作提出的最重要的开放性问题（参见第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: The cost of running this curation model over the full training corpus is negligible compared to training the downstream world model. paragraphs.en: Additionally, we want to test the capabilities of this model on a larger and more varied set, preferably from real world data rather than gameplay. An ideal dataset would be robotic manipulation corpora, which have video and exact robot actions for a wide variety of tasks and settings. This would present a much greater challenge to the LeCuration model and show its full potential for data curation in the physical AI space. We are confident that our approach, once refined, can introduce a paradigm shift in the sourcing and curating of data for all types of models, and we are excited to see where the industry takes it from here.

paragraphs.en: The DiT was designed to be completely separate from the core world model, namely the latent encoder and predictor, and serve only as a visualization tool. We found that a DiT was not strictly necessary as a visualization tool once the model saw enough of our data. At that point, we found that we could randomly sample 1 1 million frames from our dataset and create a nearest neighbor retrieval index from their world state embeddings. By snapping autoregressively generated world states with their nearest neighbor as we did in Section 3.2 , we were able to create more interpretable roll out videos (mainly because the real frames fetched from the dataset were clearer than those generated by the DiT).
paragraphs.zh: DiT 的设计初衷是使其与核心世界模型（即潜在编码器和预测器）完全分离，仅作为可视化工具使用。 我们发现，一旦模型接触过足够多的数据，DiT 作为可视化工具就不再严格必要了。 到了那个阶段，我们发现可以从数据集中随机采样 100 万帧，并基于这些帧的世界状态嵌入构建一个最近邻检索索引。 通过像第 3.2 节中那样，将自回归生成的世界状态与其最近邻进行匹配，我们得以创建出更具可解释性的展开视频（这主要是因为从数据集中获取的真实帧比 DiT 生成的图像更清晰）。

sents.en: By snapping autoregressively generated world states with their nearest neighbor as we did in Section 3.2 , we were able to create more interpretable roll out videos (mainly because the real frames fetched from the dataset were clearer than those generated by the DiT).
sents.zh: 通过像第 3.2 节中那样，将自回归生成的世界状态与其最近邻进行匹配，我们得以创建出更具可解释性的展开视频（这主要是因为从数据集中获取的真实帧比 DiT 生成的图像更清晰）。

paragraphs.en: This allowed us to better understand some of the divergence points. For example, if the ground truth video showed a fellow player passing by and obscuring a large section of the screen, this could cause a divergence. The DiT would not be able to clearly depict the passing player, as such scenes were rare in its training data.

paragraphs.en: However, for future work, we would recommend using both a DiT and nearest-neighbor retrieval to understand generated video. Nearest-neighbor retrieval only worked well for this dataset because all the scenes come from the same relatively small and closed map ( de_dust2 ). It may still help make interpretable generated videos in other cases, but with a more varied dataset a DiT would be helpful in decoding and interpolating world states that represent richer data.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，对于未来的工作，我们建议同时使用 DiT 和最近邻检索来理解生成的视频。 最近邻检索之所以能在这个数据集上良好运行，是因为所有场景都来自同一张相对较小且封闭的地图（de_dust2）。 在其他情况下，这种方法可能仍然有助于生成可解释的视频，但对于更多样化的数据集，DiT 将有助于解码和插值能够代表更丰富数据的世界状态。
